correctness.rationale: For the orientation-preserving small-epsilon lift F_e, the two-step return H_e=F_e^2-1 has first-order drift 2a(1+cos4πx) with quadratic zeros x=1/4,3/4. Independent symbolic Taylor reconstruction confirmed the cubic bottleneck jets A=16π²a, B_+=4π²c(4a+c), B_-=4π²c(c-4a), C_+=2π²c²(4a+c), C_-=2π²c²(4a-c), and identical minima K=π²c²(16a²-c²)/(4a). K>0 yields uniformly one-signed drift and I_e~2π/(sqrt(AK)|e|²), and derivative bound ||D_e' ||=O(|e|) controls discrete passage/integral error; rotation identity rho(H)=2rho(F)-1 gives signed quadratic coefficient π|c|sqrt(16a²-c²)/2. For K<0 continuity forces 2-periodic locking; c=0 has exact periodic orbit. Both signs of e, fixed parameters and |c|=4a exclusion are respected. Finite symbolic checks support but do not prove the passage-time theorem.
